name: Slash Commands Jp
description:
Displays all Claude Code slash commands in Japanese, organized by category and accompanied by practical business
use cases. Automatically fetches the latest commands from the official documentation, so it stays in sync with new
releases and deprecations. Designed for Japanese-speaking developers and beginners who want a clear,
comprehensive command reference at a glance.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `list` (Claude Code の全スラッシュコマンドを公式ドキュメントから最新取得し、カテゴリ別に日本語＋業務実例つきで表示します。自動最新化対応。/list と明示的に呼ばれた時のみ起動します。).

Installs with `claude plugin install slash-commands-jp@claude-community` from `keitashimoda24-maker/slash-commands-jp`.

English | 日本語

Displays all Claude Code slash commands in Japanese, organized by category and accompanied by practical business
use cases. Automatically fetches the latest commands from the official documentation, so it stays in sync with new
releases and deprecations. Designed for Japanese-speaking developers and beginners who want a clear,
comprehensive command reference at a glance.
